       (workload.get_opt_seq_cost), sampling candidates when many remain.
    2. First-improvement hill climbing over insertion moves: accept the

       with limited plateau walking to drift across flat regions.
    3. ILS: perturb the incumbent with a few random relocations, re-climb,
       keep improvements; adaptive perturbation strength when stalled.
    """
    import time
    n = workload.num_txns
    time_limit = 80.0  # seconds per workload, keeps total under 360s
    deadline = time.time() + time_limit

    def greedy_once(num_samples):
        start_txn = random.randint(0, n - 1)
        txn_seq = [start_txn]
        remaining = [x for x in range(n) if x != start_txn]
        while remaining:

            best_txn = None

                if best_cost is None or cost < best_cost:
                    best_cost = cost
                    best_txn = t
            txn_seq.append(best_txn)
            remaining.remove(best_txn)
        return workload.get_opt_seq_cost(txn_seq), txn_seq

    def local_search(seq, cost, plateau_budget=6):
        """First-improvement insertion + swap hill climbing with limited
        plateau walking: occasionally accept equal-cost moves to drift
        across flat regions toward a descent."""
        seq = list(seq)
        improved = True
        plateaus = 0
        while improved and time.time() < deadline:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n):
                if time.time() >= deadline:
                    break
                t = seq.pop(i)
                for j in range(n):
                    if j == i:
                        continue
                    seq.insert(j, t)

                    if c < cost or (c == cost and plateaus < plateau_budget
                                    and random.random() < 0.3):
                        if c < cost:
                            plateaus = 0
                        else:

                        cost = c
                        improved = True
                        break
                    del seq[j]
                else:
                    seq.insert(i, t)
                    for j in range(n):
                        if j == i:
                            continue
                        seq[i], seq[j] = seq[j], seq[i]
                        c = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(seq)
                        if c < cost:
                            cost = c
                            improved = True
                            break
                        seq[i], seq[j] = seq[j], seq[i]
                    continue

        return cost, seq

        """Apply k random relocations to the sequence."""
        s = list(seq)
        for _ in range(k):

            i = random.randrange(len(s))
            j = random.randrange(len(s))
            t = s.pop(i)
            s.insert(j, t)
        return s

    for r in range(max(1, num_seqs)):

            break
        c, s = greedy_once(12)
        c, s = local_search(s, c)
        if best_cost is None or c < best_cost:
            best_cost, best_seq = c, s

    stall = 0
